Safeguard.effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.

Sparkling Aria.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. *If an effected Pokemon had any level of Burn Status Condition, heal it instead of dealing damage.

Toxic Spikes.effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.

Uproar.effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.

decisions.Safeguard: Own side, four rounds including cast round; all new structured conditions blocked, existing conditions retained. Reuses current force-field bypass rules for hostile sources and removal by Screen Cleaner/Defog.
decisions.Sparkling Aria: Per target: existing Burn cure and Support conversion retained; unburned targets complete normal Special damage and a successful zero-dice effect.
decisions.Toxic Spikes: Install persistent opponents-of-side hazard; no video-game layer stacking. Existing entry handler rolls one host Chance die, Poison normally or Badly Poisoned on six; existing Ground immunity, Boots, status protection and hazard removals retained.
decisions.Uproar: Normal Random Foe damage, GM records the foe as in the existing targeting pipeline. Successful effect establishes all-field Sleep cure for the remainder of this round, including later inflictions/entries. Soundproof and Comatose retained. This is not a multi-turn rampage.
